enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed scrolling YouTube and WhatsApp, delaying sleep despite an early alarm habit
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back on the bed. Pull the phone off the bedside table. Unlock the phone with thumb. Open the YouTube app. Scroll the home feed with right thumb. Tap a video. Hold the phone above the face with both hands. Watch the screen. Scroll down to the next video. Tap it. Press the side button to lower the volume. Switch to the WhatsApp app. Open the household group chat. Read messages. Type a reply with both thumbs. Send it. Scroll the chat history. Open another chat. Type a message. Send it. Tap the next YouTube thumbnail. Continue scrolling with right thumb while lying on the side. Pull the duvet up to the chest. Place the phone face-down on the mattress. Pick it up again. Continue scrolling until 01:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in after a late night, catching up on rest on a weekend morning
enriched_activities.desc: Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn onto the right side. Pull the duvet up over the shoulder. Close eyes. Sleep. Shift onto the back. Turn onto the left side. Pull the pillow under the head. Sleep. Roll onto the stomach. Push the duvet down with the arm. Sleep. Pull the duvet back up. Turn onto the back again. Sleep. At 09:30 open eyes and lie still in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and taking a warm shower to wake up slowly (bathroom free, Member 3 finished at 09:00 and Member 4 at 08:40)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Bend over the sink. Cup water in both hands. Splash water on the face. Pick up the soap. Rub it between the hands. Apply lather to the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Step into the shower area. Turn the shower tap to warm. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the body wash. Pour it onto the hand. Rub it over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the waist. Turn off the bathroom light. Pull the door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and brewing a strong cup of tea, then cooking a breakfast that fits dietary restrictions
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Take the kettle from the counter. Fill it with water at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a spoon. Put the spoon on the counter. Open the refrigerator. Take out the eggs and vegetables. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator. Take a bowl from the cupboard. Crack two eggs on the rim of the bowl. Pour the eggs into the bowl. Pick up the fork. Beat the eggs with the fork. Pick up the kettle as it clicks off. Pour hot water into the mug. Set the kettle down. Place the frying pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the eggs in the pan. Press the range hood button. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto a plate. Pick up the mug. Carry the plate and mug to the counter. Sit on the stool. Eat the eggs with the fork. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate and mug. Place them in the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing daily stretching routine and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Roll out the yoga mat on the floor. Stand on the mat. Raise both arms overhead. Bend forward and reach towards the toes. Hold the position. Stand up. Step the right foot back into a lunge. Hold. Switch to the left foot. Hold. Sit on the mat. Stretch the right leg forward and reach for the toes. Switch to the left leg. Stand up. Roll up the mat. Put the mat in the corner. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a t-shirt. Take out trousers. Lay them on the bed. Take off the towel. Pull on the t-shirt. Pull on the trousers. Open the drawer. Take out socks. Put on the socks. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Put the phone in the pocket. Walk to the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the shared living space and catching up on overdue cleaning chores while Member 3 and Member 4 are out grocery shopping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Place the cushions on the couch. Pick up the empty cups from the coffee table. Carry the cups to the kitchen sink. Return to the living room. Pick up the TV remote. Place it on the shelf. Fold the throw blanket. Place it on the arm of the couch. Pick up the game controller. Put it in the drawer. Take the cloth from the shelf. Wipe the coffee table surface. Wipe the TV stand. Take the broom from the corner. Sweep the floor from the door towards the window. Sweep the dust into the dustpan. Tip the dustpan into the bin. Put the broom back. Take the vacuum cleaner. Plug it in. Press the power button. Vacuum the rug. Press the power button off. Unplug the vacuum. Wind the cord around the hook. Put the vacuum in the corner. Push the chairs back under the table. Walk to Bedroom 2 to put away the cleaning cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market, checking prices carefully and picking up weekly staples
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the reusable shopping bags. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk to the car. Unlock the car with the key fob. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Close the door. Fasten the seat belt. Start the engine. Drive out of the car park. Drive to the local market. Park the car. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Walk into the market. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk to the vegetable stall. Pick up a bag of carrots. Check the price tag. Place the carrots in the basket. Pick up tomatoes. Weigh them on the scale. Place them in the basket. Walk to the fruit stall. Pick up bananas. Place them in the basket. Walk to the dairy aisle. Take a carton of milk. Check the expiry date. Place it in the basket. Take a block of cheese. Place it in the basket. Walk to the dry goods aisle. Take a bag of rice. Place it in the basket. Take pasta. Place it in the basket. Walk to the counter. Place the basket on the counter. Watch the cashier scan the items. Open the wallet. Take out the card. Tap the card on the reader. Put the card back. Place the items into the reusable bags. Pick up the bags. Walk back to the car.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving back home with the groceries
enriched_activities.desc: Open the car boot. Lift the grocery bags into the boot. Close the boot. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Close the door. Fasten the seat belt. Start the engine. Check the mirrors. Turn the steering wheel to leave the car park. Drive onto the road. Stop at the traffic light. Accelerate when the light turns green. Turn left at the junction. Pull into the driveway. Park the car. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Open the boot. Lift the grocery bags out. Carry them to the front door. Set the bags down. Take out the key. Unlock the door. Pick up the bags. Carry them inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple lunch at home and eating it together with Member 3 while checking messages
enriched_activities.desc: Set the grocery bags on the kitchen counter. Take out the vegetables. Open the refrigerator door. Place the milk and cheese inside. Close the door. Open the cupboard. Place the rice and pasta inside. Close the cupboard. Take the pan from the hook. Place it on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board. Slide the vegetables into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add salt from the shaker. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food onto two plates. Greet Member 3 and say "Lunch is ready". Carry the plates to the table. Sit down opposite Member 3. Pick up the fork. Eat the lunch. Pick up the phone. Open the messaging app. Read messages. Type a reply with both thumbs. Send it. Place the phone on the table. Continue eating. Stand up. Carry both plates to the sink. Rinse the plates. Place them in the drying rack. Say "Thanks for eating with me" to Member 3.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance design projects at the computer and monitor, refining a client layout
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Sit on the chair at the desk. Press the computer power button. Pull the keyboard towards the body. Move the mouse. Open the design software file. Scroll the layout with the mouse wheel. Click the text box. Highlight the heading text. Change the font size in the panel. Click the image layer. Drag the image to the left of the canvas. Adjust the width by dragging the handle. Open the colour picker. Select a colour swatch. Apply it to the background shape. Press the keyboard shortcut to save. Click the alignment tool. Align the logo to the top margin. Zoom out to check the whole layout. Zoom back in. Type new body text on the keyboard. Delete a paragraph. Retype it. Open the client brief document. Read it on the monitor. Switch back to the design file. Move the mouse to the export menu. Export a preview image. Open the email client. Attach the preview image. Type the subject line. Type the message body on the keyboard. Click send. Pick up the phone. Check the notification. Put the phone down. Continue adjusting the layout until 15:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Making another cup of tea and having a small snack while standing at the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk to the kitchen. Take the kettle. Fill it with water at the tap. Place it on the base. Press the switch down. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Open the biscuit tin. Take out two biscuits. Place them on a small plate. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Set the kettle down. Pick up the mug. Pick up the plate. Stand at the counter. Dip a biscuit into the tea. Eat the biscuit. Drink the tea. Pick up the phone. Check messages while standing. Reply to one message. Put the phone down. Finish the tea. Carry the mug and plate to the sink. Rinse them. Place them in the drying rack. Walk back to Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance creative work and sketching concepts with art supplies on the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Move the mouse. Wake the monitor. Open a new document in the design software. Draw a rectangle shape with the mouse. Add a text layer. Type the concept title. Open the sketchbook on the desk. Pick up the pencil. Sketch a rough layout on the paper. Erase a line with the eraser. Draw again. Pick up the ruler. Draw straight guide lines. Put the ruler down. Pick up the coloured marker. Add colour to the sketch. Put the marker back in the box. Pick up the phone. Take a photo of the sketch. Open the design software. Import the photo. Place it beside the digital layout. Adjust the size with the mouse. Compare the two. Type notes on the keyboard. Click save. Open the client email. Read the reply. Type a response on the keyboard. Click send. Stand up. Stretch both arms overhead. Sit down again. Continue editing until 18:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a slow stretching session and resting the eyes away from screens
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Walk into the living room. Roll out the yoga mat on the floor. Step onto the mat. Stand with feet apart. Raise the arms overhead. Bend to the right side. Hold. Bend to the left side. Hold. Bend forward towards the toes. Hold. Stand up slowly. Roll the shoulders backwards. Turn the head slowly to the right. Turn the head to the left. Sit on the mat. Cross the legs. Place both hands on the knees. Close the eyes. Breathe slowly. Open the eyes. Stand up. Roll up the mat. Place the mat in the corner. Sit on the couch. Look out of the window.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch and eating it together with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the couch. Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out the vegetables and protein. Close the refrigerator. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chopped vegetables. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add the protein to the pan. Add sauce from the bottle. Press the range hood button. Stir again. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Slide the food onto four plates. Say to Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4 "Dinner is ready". Carry the plates to the table. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner. Talk with Member 1 about the work shift. Pass the water jug to Member 4. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the empty plates to the sink. Place them on the counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game on the console with Member 1 and Member 4 to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit on the couch next to Member 1. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the power button. Press the input button. Pick up the game console controller. Press the home button. Scroll the game menu with the joystick. Select a game. Press the start button. Hold the controller with both hands. Play the game. Press the jump button with the right thumb. Press the action button. Pass the second controller to Member 4. Say "Your turn". Watch the screen. Laugh and say "Nice one" to Member 4. Take the controller back. Play another round. Pause the game. Pick up the phone. Check a message. Put the phone down. Resume the game. Play until 21:00. Press the pause button. Place the controller on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a quick shower and starting a load of laundry in the washing machine (bathroom and washing machine free, before Member 1's 21:30 shower)
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the couch. Walk to Bedroom 2. Pick up the laundry basket. Carry it to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the washing machine door. Pull out the clothes from the basket. Load the clothes into the drum. Close the machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the compartment. Close the drawer. Press the power button. Turn the dial to select the cycle. Press the start button. Step into the shower area. Turn on the shower tap. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Apply shampoo. Rinse the hair. Apply body wash to the arms and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Put on the t-shirt and trousers. Turn off the bathroom light. Pull the door open. Walk out with the basket.

enriched_activities.activity: Meeting a large group of friends at a cafe and live music event, staying out socially
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the laundry basket back to Bedroom 2. Place the basket on the floor. Pick up the phone. Read the message about the meeting point. Pick up the wallet. Put it in the pocket. Pick up the car keys. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk to the car. Unlock the car. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Fasten the seat belt. Start the engine. Drive to the cafe. Park the car. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Step out. Close the door. Lock the car. Walk into the cafe. Greet the friends and wave. Sit down at the table. Order a drink from the waiter. Pick up the drink. Take a sip. Talk with the friends. Stand up and walk to the stage area. Listen to the live music. Clap after the song. Return to the table. Pick up the drink. Talk with a friend. Pick up the phone. Take a photo of the band. Show the photo to the friend. Continue talking until 23:15. Say goodbye to the group. Walk back to the car.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving home from the social event
enriched_activities.desc: Unlock the car. Open the driver door. Sit in the driver seat. Close the door. Fasten the seat belt. Start the engine. Check the mirrors. Drive out of the parking spot. Stop at the junction. Accelerate onto the main road. Drive through two traffic lights. Turn into the driveway. Park the car. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Lock the car. Walk to the front door. Take out the key. Unlock the door. Step inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed browsing YouTube and WhatsApp, catching up on messages before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Close the door. Take the phone out of the pocket. Place it on the bedside table. Take off the t-shirt. Take off the trousers. Pull on the pyjamas. Pull back the duvet. Lie down on the bed. Pull the duvet up to the chest. Pick up the phone. Unlock it with thumb. Open WhatsApp. Read the unread messages in the group chat. Type a reply with both thumbs. Send it. Open another chat. Type a reply. Send it. Switch to YouTube. Scroll the feed with the right thumb. Tap a video. Watch it. Scroll to the next video. Tap it. Play the video. Press the side button to turn the screen off. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn onto the right side. Pull the duvet over the shoulder.
